theorem lg_target (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) : x + 1 / x ≥ 2 := by
  have h1 : (x + 1 / x) / 2 ≥ sqrt (x * (1 / x)) :=
    Real.am_gm x (1 / x)
  have h2 : sqrt (x * (1 / x)) = 1 :=
    by rw [mul_inv_rev, inv_mul_self, mul_one]
  have h3 : (x + 1 / x) / 2 ≥ 1 :=
    by rw [h2]; exact h1
  rw [mul_div_eq_div_mul_right] at h3
  exact h3
